requirements.text: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field
Proven track record of managing milestone-driven projects and reporting to senior management
Solid understanding of budgets, payment plans, and financial reporting
Experience with project management and planning tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, or Smartsheet
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
Experience in aerospace, industrial, or other highly regulated environments
Knowledge of lump sum EU funding or German national funding programmes

resumes.text:
Laura Brandt
Senior Project Manager

Summary
Highly structured and proactive project manager with over eight years of experience delivering engineering and industrial programmes on time and within budget. Known for building trust with executives, engineers and suppliers, and for clear communication under pressure.

Experience
Senior Project Manager, Northwind Motion Systems, Stuttgart (March 2019 to present)
- Delivered six phase-gated product launches on schedule, briefing the executive board every quarter on status, risks and forecast.
- Maintained the integrated project plan for a 40 million euro production line expansion, tracking spend against budget and forecasting cash flow each month.
- Produced monthly financial reporting for the programme, reconciling supplier payment plans against approved budget lines.
- Ran steering committee meetings, risk registers and change control, escalating decisions when scope shifted.
- Built and maintained schedules in Microsoft Project and Jira, linking engineering tickets to programme deadlines.
- Acted as single point of contact for three external engineering partners, aligning six department heads who had previously worked in silos.
- Led three years of supplier qualification work for an avionics customer, operating under strict aerospace quality audits.
- Managed reporting for a US Department of Energy research grant, preparing annual technical and financial submissions.

Project Coordinator, Harlow Mechanical Ltd, Leeds, UK (June 2016 to February 2019)
- Coordinated installation and maintenance schedules across two plants.
- Tracked more than 300 actions in Smartsheet, halving the number of overdue tasks.
- Prepared weekly progress reports for plant directors.

Education
MSc Mechanical Engineering, University of Bristol, 2016
BEng Engineering Management, University of Leeds, 2014

Skills
Programme delivery, budget control, financial reporting, risk management, change control, Microsoft Project, Jira, Smartsheet, English (native).

Marcus Hale
Project Manager

Summary
Project manager with three years of experience running digital and operational projects for retail clients. Strong stakeholder management skills and clear communication with business owners. Fluent in English and conversational Spanish.

Experience
Project Manager, Brightway Retail Solutions, Manchester (January 2022 to present)
- Tracked spend against a 1.2 million euro project budget and produced monthly cost forecasts for the finance team.
- Ran weekly status meetings with store operations, IT and procurement, resolving blockers quickly.
- Set up and maintained project plans and dashboards in Jira for a team of twelve.
- Keeps a weekly action tracker that the whole team updates, so nothing slips between meetings.
- Coordinated the rollout of a new point-of-sale system across 45 stores, delivered on time.

Assistant Project Officer, Coastline Events Group, Liverpool (May 2019 to December 2021)
- Supported the planning of venue fit-out projects and kept delivery timelines on track.
- Prepared reports on project progress and cost variances for senior staff.
- Maintained contractor schedules and purchase orders for each event.

Education
BSc Business Management, Manchester Metropolitan University, 2019

Skills
Project planning, cost tracking, stakeholder communication, Jira, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint, process improvement, conversational Spanish, English (fluent).

Chloe Mercer
Hotel Operations Supervisor

Summary
Hospitality professional with six years of experience running front-of-house teams in busy hotels and restaurants. Known for warm guest service and calm handling of complaints. Fluent in English.

Experience
Operations Supervisor, Harbour View Hotel, Brighton (April 2021 to present)
- Supervised a team of 14 front-desk and concierge staff across three shifts.
- Handled guest complaints at the front desk, turning difficult stays into positive reviews.
- Organised weekly rota planning and staff training sessions.
- Coordinated weddings and corporate events for up to 200 guests, from menu tasting to room layout.
- Reviewed guest feedback each week and passed patterns to the housekeeping and kitchen leads.

Restaurant Manager, The Copper Pot, Brighton (March 2017 to March 2021)
- Managed daily bookings, floor service and cash handling for a 90-seat restaurant.
- Reduced food waste through a weekly stock check routine.
- Trained new hires on point-of-sale procedures and food safety.
- Hosted seasonal tasting evenings and handled ticket sales at the door.

Waiter and Bar Staff, Seaview Brasserie, Hove (June 2015 to February 2017)
- Served lunch and evening guests and kept tables turning efficiently.
- Learned to close the bar at the end of each night, counting the till.

Education
BA Hospitality Management, Brighton Metropolitan College, 2017

Skills
Guest relations, team supervision, event coordination, rota planning, food safety, point-of-sale systems, English (fluent).
